canImplementInterfaceForAddress(bytes32,.details: In this implementation, the `_addr` (the address for which the contract will implement the interface) is always `address(this)`.

params._interfaceHash: keccak256 hash of the name of the interface.

returns._0: ERC1820_ACCEPT_MAGIC only if the contract implements `ìnterfaceHash` for the address `_addr`.

isOperatorForPartitionScope(bytes32,addr.details: The `_operator` address param is unused. For this strategy, this will be being called on behalf of suppliers, as they have sent their tokens to the collateral manager address, and are now trying to execute a transfer from the pool. This implies that the pool sender hook MUST be implemented in such a way as to restrict any unauthorized transfers, as the partitions affected by this strategy will allow all callers to make an attempt to transfer from the collateral managers partition.

params._tokenHolder: The collateral manager holding the pool of tokens.

returns._0: The operator check for this strategy returns true if the partition owner (identified by the final 20 bytes of the partition) is the same as the token holder address, as in this case the token holder is the collateral manager address.

tokensFromPartitionToValidate(bytes4,byt.details: Placeholder to satisfy IAmpPartitionSpaceValidator interface that can be overridden by parent.

tokensToPartitionToValidate(bytes4,bytes.details: The `_toPartition` must be formatted with the PARTITION_PREFIX as the first 4 bytes, the `_to` value as the final 20 bytes. The 8 bytes in the middle can be used by the manager to create sub partitions within their impelemntation.

params._to: The address of the collateral manager.
params._toPartition: The partition the tokens are transferred to.
